posts.title: At Least Write Your Own README
posts.description: The tagline on Jeffrey Archer’s debut novel Not a Penny More, Not a Penny Less , reads “Don’t get mean. Get even.” It’s a good phrase. It implies a preference for ruthless pragmatism over outrage. So in the spirit of not getting mean, and remaining on task, I am penning this short article imploring people to write their own README files by hand, without an LLM. posts.title: Apple, Please Stop Deleting My Books
posts.description: On a recent flight from Las Vegas to New York, I was baffled by an iOS storage decision that left me quite bored. When opening the native Books app on my iPhone, where I spend most flights reading, I found to my dismay those little cloud icons next to the books indicating that they were not downloaded locally to my phone, and only remained present in iCloud.
